description: Memorandum in the name of Bū l-Ḥasan b. Wuhayb (not the same ḍāmin as Abū l-Ḥasan b. Wahb) for his ḍamān on dyeing in Madīnat al-Fayyūm. Undated. The year for which the tax is paid is 544 (1150). Will be published in Bondioli, Luescher, Rustow, and Vanthieghem as doc. 58.
description_he: מסמך ממלכתי בערבית מהמאה ה-12. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
